summary: Verified both iteration_14 fixes end-to-end. (1) admin.html '[object Object]' fix: confirmed backend serves updated admin.html at localhost:8001/admin with the new detail-stringification block (lines 436-455); curl reproduced the exact 422 payload (detail=array-of-dicts) from /api/auth/request-otp with non-integer telegramId; ran the JS logic against the live 422 payload via browser evaluate — output is 'Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer' with NO '[object Object]'. Also verified the object-shape branch against the 426 EXTENSION_OUTDATED response (used by /api/admin/stats when middleware blocks). (2) DM-spam defense: all 11 DM tests in test_outdated_extension_dm.py pass, including the new test_dm_skipped_when_sent_version_at_or_above_fallback_floor. Regression suite (version-gate + honeypot + self-heal + paywall-loop + global-gate) 34/34 still passes. New /api/admin/stats shape test confirms exact keys consumed by loadStats() (users.total/active/banned, hits.total/charged, codes.unused/used). Total: 41 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed.

minor.issue: External preview URL https://<host>/admin returns the React frontend (blank SPA), NOT /app/backend/static/admin.html. K8s ingress only proxies /api/* to backend port 8001. Admin panel is only reachable at localhost:8001/admin from inside the container. If the user is expected to open /admin in a browser from the internet, ingress needs an explicit rule for /admin (and probably / or /static) → 8001. NOT caused by iteration_14 changes.

Currently /admin resolves to the React frontend and yields a blank page. Users must hit the backend origin directly. OPTIONAL: Move the '_FALLBACK_MIN_VERSION' constant + _is_valid_semver helper into a shared module (still duplicated across routes/data.py, routes/public.py, routes/admin.py). Pointed out in iteration_13; still not addressed.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.html detail-stringification fix (lines 436-455) is defensive and correct: handles all three FastAPI detail shapes (string, array of validation dicts, plain error object). Fallback to JSON.stringify guarantees no '[object Object]' can leak. Good.

server.py DM-spam defense: skipping DM when sent_version >= _FALLBACK_MIN_VERSION is the right call — prevents mass DM storm during future DB corruption episodes. Tuple-compare across '2.3.9' vs '3' still triggers 426 middleware (as it must, so client shows paywall), but the DM helper is gated separately. Clean separation.

Consider also gating the client-side 426 toast on the extension side to fetch fresh /api/public/version and self-recover if a bogus min-version was pushed — currently users must restart or wait for cache TTL.
Admin panel is a single 815-line HTML file with inline JS. If it grows further, split into external .js files for maintainability. Not urgent.

rca of the issue: Original '[object Object]' bug: admin.html api() helper only handled string `detail`. When FastAPI returned Pydantic 422 (detail=array of dicts) or a rich error object (detail={code,message,...} for 426 EXTENSION_OUTDATED), `new Error(j.detail)` coerced the object into '[object Object]'. Fixed by branching on typeof/Array.isArray. Original DM-spam bug: a corrupted extension_releases row (version='3') made _get_min_extension_version return '3'; tuple-compare '3' vs '2.3.9' → outdated → 426 + DM to every user. Iteration_13 self-healed the version read path; iteration_14 adds a defense-in-depth gate: only DM if sent_version < FALLBACK floor, so even if the read path regresses again, users on current builds won't be DM-spammed.
